Name: (CP) Qi Themed Furniture
Author: AngelOfStars
Description:
[size=3]This mod [i]adds[/i] 180 'Qi Themed' furniture pieces to the game using Content Patcher, as well as 16 floors, 16 wallpapers, and configs to make your kitchen and crib match the two wood types for the furniture.

I made all of this for my mod [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31511]Friendable Mr.Qi[/url] but figured people might like the furniture by itself! [[b][i]If you have the mod you do not need this one[/i][/b]]

You can aquire the furniture from the Vanilla Catalogue as long as you have the config setting "Exclude from Vanilla Catalogue" set to true (it is false by default) Wallpapers and Flooring are much the same.

Alternatively you can install [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20628]Calcifer[/url] and use the Qi Furniture Catalogue to purchase the items which you can buy from Qi's Casino for 500,000 Qi coins (price is also configurable)

You can also use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url] and type in "Qi" to find the furniture.

If you have [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]Spacecore[/url] installed the furniture will have descriptions.

If you have [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20537]PIF[/url] installed you can toggle the doors to be PIF doors. 

To edit configs use [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]

Installation:
1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
2. Install this mod.
3. Extract all and drop them into your Mods folder.

If you have any other suggestions I can try to make them!

For Translators: 
You may upload your translation file to Nexus, just be sure to make this mod a requirement + don't upload the actual code!

[b][i][center]If you like the stuff I make, consider sending me a [url=https://ko-fi.com/lilydoesthingssometimes]ko-fi[/url]﻿ - never required of course, I do this stuff for fun, but it does make it easier to focus on making things.[/center][/i][/b]

[/size]Credits: 
Just Concerned Ape because I would not know where to start with pixel art with out him :)
